title: Later Western Liang
capsule: The Western Liang of the Southern dynasties was a rump successor of the Liang dynasty, ruled by the Xiao clan from its capital at Jiangling. It survived as a client state under the protection of the Western Wei, Northern Zhou, and then Sui. It was absorbed by the Sui dynasty in 587.
